desc: Derive structural characterization: snowflake = center c + nonempty middles M ⊆ N(c), each middle with exactly y ≥ 1 kept leaf-children; capacity of middle = deg(m)−1; induced condition automatic in trees; degenerate cases (stars, P3) covered by allowing x=1 and trying all centers including leaves.

Design algorithm: per center c, kept(c) = 1 + max_{k≥1, c_k≥1} k·(1+c_k) over descending sorted capacities; global answer = N − max_c kept(c). Verified on all three samples (1, 0, 3). Rooting/DP unnecessary — closed form suffices.
Implement solution in Python (fast input via sys.stdin.buffer, adjacency lists, per-center sort; total O(N log N)) and write final code block.

Validate: samples 1–3 pass; brute-force cross-check on all labeled trees N=3..8 and 2000 random trees each N=9..12 all match; edge cases (star, path, N=3) and performance on N=3×10^5 confirmed (~0.6 s worst case).
